statement: Exact finite and twisted Massey vanishing results, with the coefficient, predecessor, ramification and inverse-limit gaps in applying them to one ordinary integral section.
depends_on: Harpaz-Wittenberg Theorems1.3/7.4 and Proposition7.3; Maire-Minac-Ramakrishna-Tan Theorems1.1/1.2/3.2/4.2; A6; A20-A24; E148; E159
checks: Additional primary-source scope audit; no historical theorem refuted.
notes: Theorem7.4 is applied with Ni=Fp(-i). The 2026 strong result uses trivial coefficients and excludes fields containing zeta_p. Finite modulus lifts do not supply the retained integral predecessor or common ordinary path.
